description: Defines internal debug and logging functions, macros, external variable references, and constants used for logging control within the RDK platform.

methods.name: rdk_logger_envGet
methods.description: Retrieves the value of an environment variable by name.

methods.name: rdk_logger_env_add_conf_file
methods.description: Sets up environment variable storage by parsing a specified configuration file.

methods.name: rdk_logger_env_rem_conf_details
methods.description: Removes or clears configuration details related to environment variables.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_priv_Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down and cleans up debugging resources.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_priv_LogControlOpSysIntf
methods.description: Provides log control operations through system interface.

methods.name: rdk_dbg_priv_LogQueryOpSysIntf
methods.description: Queries log configuration through system interface.

methods.name: rdk_debug_priv_log_msg
methods.description: Logs a message with specified log level, module information, and formatted message.
